name: Grok-2 mini

lifecycle.note: xAI has published no deprecation or retirement notice for Grok-2 mini; the xAI API models page lists no Grok-2 model (checked 2026-10-01).

released.note: Released in beta on X together with Grok-2; enterprise API access was announced for later in August 2024.

summary.text: Grok-2 mini is a smaller language model that xAI released alongside Grok-2 on 13 August 2024, describing it as a sibling of Grok-2 that balances speed and answer quality. It launched in beta on X for Premium and Premium+ subscribers, with access through an enterprise API announced for later that month.

changes.text: A smaller sibling of Grok-2 that xAI says balances speed and answer quality.
xAI says it improves on its previous model, Grok-1.5.

sources.locator: second paragraph; Build with Grok using the Enterprise API

access.note: At launch in beta on X for Premium and Premium+ users, with the enterprise API announced for later in August 2024.

notes: First model of the mini tier; no predecessor relation. xAI calls it a small but capable sibling of Grok-2, which is not recorded as a variant relation. Input modalities are not stated for Grok-2 mini, although the announcement's benchmark table includes visual tasks for it, so multimodal is not recorded.
